name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for all things mechanical, fueled by his grandfather's auto repair shop in Guadalajara. He honed his skills through vocational training and quickly found his niche in fabrication, developing a keen eye for detail and an unwavering commitment to precision. He initially worked on restoring classic cars before transitioning to single-seater racing, driven by the challenge of pushing engineering limits.

At Racing Bulls, Ricardo approaches every project with meticulous care, ensuring that each component meets the highest standards. He’s known for his dedication to problem-solving, often spending extra hours refining his work until it meets his exacting standards. While his technical skills are impressive, his ability to collaborate effectively and mentor junior fabricators truly sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height, with a wiry build honed from years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and technical diagrams.
Has a habit of whistling softly while working, often old Mexican folk songs.
Meticulously cleans his tools at the end of each day, regardless of how tired he is.
